friendLines.title: Hello
friendLines.description: You smell... *sniff* nice! Let's hunt.

friendLines.title: Chat: Scent
friendLines.description: *sniff* I smell rabbit.

friendLines.title: Chat: Hunger
friendLines.description: I'm hungry. Let's hunt.

friendLines.title: Chat: Wind-gazing
friendLines.description: I keep watch. You leave, you call me.

friendLines.title: When Thunder Strikes: Warning
friendLines.description: If you're scared of lightning, hide now.

friendLines.title: When Thunder Strikes: Guidance
friendLines.description: Avoid the trees. Follow me.

friendLines.title: When It's Windy
friendLines.description: Wind... I like the wind.

friendLines.title: When the Wind Is Blowing
friendLines.description: The wind... bites hard.

friendLines.title: Good Morning
friendLines.description: The sun is up. Time to hunt.

friendLines.title: Good Afternoon
friendLines.description: I had a big lunch. Lots of meat. Mm, I'm happy.

friendLines.title: Good Evening
friendLines.description: Go to sleep. I watch the moon.

friendLines.title: Good Night
friendLines.description: You sleep now. I keep watch.

friendLines.title: About Razor
friendLines.description: I have no human family. I am a wolf.

friendLines.title: About Us: Friends
friendLines.description: You are my friend. We can hunt. Together!

friendLines.title: About Us: Weapons
friendLines.description: I have iron claws and teeth of thunder. I protect you.

friendLines.title: About the Vision
friendLines.description: Vision helps Razor... fight with lightning tooth! Protect Lupical!

friendLines.title: Something to Share
friendLines.description: I like the stars at night. So many stars. In the sky, in the lake. And in the city.

friendLines.title: Interesting Things
friendLines.description: The wolves are my Lupical. My family.

friendLines.title: About Lisa
friendLines.description: Lisa lightning makes the sky black. She is strong. She is scary.

friendLines.title: About Barbara
friendLines.description: Shining Barbara is a good child. Very good child.

friendLines.title: About Diluc
friendLines.description: Diluc is red and black. Hot and cold.

friendLines.title: About Venti
friendLines.description: Razor doesn't know poems, but... Lupical likes them.

friendLines.title: About Bennett
friendLines.description: Bennett... Much talking. Eat with him, never full.

friendLines.title: About Klee
friendLines.description: Klee, friend! Friend, but... big hassle.

friendLines.title: About Varka: Stranger
friendLines.description: Varka? Razor doesn't know...

friendLines.title: About Varka: Memory
friendLines.description: Oh, Varka is... a name. That man big. Big steelclaw, Razor's name — Varka gave him. Oh... want to see him.

friendLines.title: More About Razor: I
friendLines.description: *sniff* Hmm... You smell kind. Do you like meat?

friendLines.title: More About Razor: II
friendLines.description: You are strong. Like a wolf. I like to hunt with you. We catch a lot.

friendLines.title: More About Razor: III
friendLines.description: Lupical means wolf home— no, Lupical means wolf family. My Lupical lives in the woods. They say I am their Lupical.

friendLines.title: More About Razor: IV
friendLines.description: My Lupical is my only family. But I don't have four legs, not like them. Because I'm not a real wolf. Sometimes, this makes me sad.

friendLines.title: More About Razor: V
friendLines.description: When I run with you, when I hunt with you, I am happy. With you, I am not a wolf, I am not a boy, I am just me. I am Razor. Because you are my friend. You are my Lupical. I hope you feel happy, too!

friendLines.title: Razor's Hobbies
friendLines.description: I like Lupical. I like the woods. I like my friend. I like to run!

friendLines.title: Razor's Troubles
friendLines.description: Talking makes me tired. Talking is... hard. But... I have to try.

friendLines.title: Favorite Food
friendLines.description: I like meat, and... I like potatoes.

friendLines.title: Least Favorite Food
friendLines.description: Greens are bad. Animal eats green things. Then I eat animal!

friendLines.title: Receiving a Gift: I
friendLines.description: Smells good, also tastes good, I like it.

friendLines.title: Receiving a Gift: II
friendLines.description: Eating this gives me energy, makes me happy.

friendLines.title: Receiving a Gift: III
friendLines.description: Eating it, bad. Not eating it, also bad. I'm a bit sad.

friendLines.title: Birthday
friendLines.description: Today is your day. You were born on this day, many moons ago. I want to make you happy today. Can we eat meat together?

friendLines.title: Feelings About Ascension: Intro
friendLines.description: Arms... bigger!

friendLines.title: Feelings About Ascension: Building Up
friendLines.description: Grr! Sharpen claws. Sharpen teeth. Become stronger!

friendLines.title: Feelings About Ascension: Climax
friendLines.description: Run... Hunt... No. No! Must... become stronger!

friendLines.title: Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion
friendLines.description: Teeth. Claws. Legs. All bigger. All stronger! To protect you.
